items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...written by Roy Eldridge and Edgar Battles... [INTERVIEWEE] You're kidding. Oh yes, that's right -- I remember that.

ctx.x: Roy Eldridge, right. Who Told You I Cared? Does Your Heart Beat For Me, I'm Getting Sentimental Over You, Can't Get Started With You -- oh, all these things -- these were my first recordings which I shall always remember. Never forget those.

Well my first recording, I think with Cab Calloway, if I remember correctly, as a soloist was doing Plucking the Bass, which was written by Roy Eldridge and Edgar Battles, and I did it with Cab Calloway.
You're kidding. Oh yes, that's right -- I remember that.
